instruction: Complete the task with a suitable choice from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD. For this workflow, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to build and solve a modal analysis model of a fixed-fixed beam. Physical problem: Modal analysis of a straight beam fixed at both ends. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The beam length is along the X direction. - The beam starts at X = 0 mm and ends at X = 500 mm. - The beam cross section is rectangular: - Width = 10 mm - Height = 10 mm Model parameters: - Element type: appropriate beam element formulation - Section type: rectangular beam section - Section size: 10 mm × 10 mm - Beam length: 500 mm - Mesh: 20 equal divisions along the beam length Material: - Use a consistent N-mm-s unit system. - Young's modulus: E = 210000 MPa, equivalent to 210000 N/mm² - Poisson's ratio: ν = 0.3 - Density: 7.85e-9 tonne/mm³, equivalent to 7850 kg/m³ Boundary conditions: - Fully constrain both beam ends: - At X = 0 mm: constrain UX, UY, UZ, ROTX, ROTY, and ROTZ. - At X = 500 mm: constrain UX, UY, UZ, ROTX, ROTY, and ROTZ. Analysis type: - Modal analysis - Extract the first 3 modes. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
